name: Warpstorm — Ultimate Battlesector Customization Tool
author: crystal-mods
description: Unit & weapon stat editor and opt-in Army Painter for Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. A BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) plugin applies stat edits to the game's live data tables in every mode (hotkey on/off, live reload) and, only when you enable it and change a colour, repaints factions — 3D models and portraits — with custom colours or curated chapter schemes (10 Space Marine chapters with badges). The Warpstorm Configurator (Windows EXE) edits everything with a game-styled UI in 10 languages, previews and bakes paint ahead of time, and includes a Scheme Creator for your own packs.

configurator.note: Self-contained single EXE shipped in the same zip, in the mod's own folder. Run it from there (or copy it anywhere).

schemes.note: Built-in Army Painter scheme packs (Ultramarines models): salamanders, space-wolves, imperial-fists, white-scars, dark-angels, raven-guard, iron-hands, black-templars, crimson-fists, blood-ravens. Each also ships as dist/scheme-<id>-v<version>.zip.

config: BepInEx/config/warpstorm/config.json (stat edits), BepInEx/config/com.crystalmods.armypainter.cfg (paint), BepInEx/config/com.crystalmods.warpstorm.cfg (settings); user scheme packs in BepInEx/config/warpstorm/schemes/; baked paint in BepInEx/cache/warpstorm/paint/.
toggle: F10 (configurable) toggles stat edits live; F9 reloads. F1 opens the in-game Army Painter window once Army Painter is opted in (BepInEx/config/com.crystalmods.armypainter.cfg [Paint] Enabled = true).

compatibility.note: Runtime plugin — adds one DLL and modifies no game file, so it has no file conflicts and stacks with any other mod (data edits, localization, Army Painter).
compatibility.the-great-crusade: Compatible (that mod edits a bundle; this edits runtime data).
compatibility.army-painter: Built in (merged into Warpstorm.dll); the standalone Army Painter mod no longer exists — do not install one.
